description: Disaggregated prefill/decode on 2 V100s: prefill GPU + decode GPU, KV moved over NVLink by NixlConnector, behind vLLM's toy proxy. Compare with dp2_v1 (same 2 GPUs, 2 full replicas)
notes: Same scenarios, durations, warmups and seed as baseline_v1, with each rate grid roughly doubled for 2 GPUs (single-GPU saturation: scheduler ~11-12, baseline ~1, kv_cache ~0.2-0.3 req/s). pd_v1 and dp2_v1 use identical grids and seeds, so their requests match one-to-one, and rates shared with baseline_v1 match it too. Replay: rate_scale doubled to 0.0038 (~1.5 req/s average). Prefix cache reset before every run.
